review_method.description: Opened and visually inspected every one of the 20 native 1920x1080 images and every one of the 20 phone 360x203 derivatives individually with view_image at original detail. Batches contained no more than two native images. Preserved per-image observations, then compared the repeated characters within each anonymous five-scene bundle and assigned the six fixed integer 1-5 category scores before any identity reveal.
review_method.identity_blinding: Only packet.json and images inside this neutral review folder were read. No source, receipts, parent or sibling files, identity mapping, provider information or model identities were accessed or inferred. No generation, other model calls, UI actions, image edits or subagents were used.
review_method.eligibility_interpretation: Eligibility is separate from aesthetic quality. A scene must visibly stage its material required action and characters as awake, adult and appropriately clothed, without text or forbidden exposure. The 5% safe margin applies to heads, hands, meaningful feet, crossed knees and important foreground scene props. Background branches are allowed at edges. The isolated throne root in P01, stepping root in P02 and fallen branch in P04 were treated as important scene props; the broad forest canopy and layered environmental roots in P05 were treated as setting. Missing unmistakable knee crossing/seat bracing or visible safe-margin failures cause eligible=false. Other observed craft, acting, pose-detail and costume weaknesses remain in scores and comments rather than being erased by the gate.
review_method.continuity_review: Reviewed Titania between P01/P05, Helena between P02/P04 and Hermia between P03/P04 within each of Set-A, Set-B, Set-C and Set-D. Puck has no repeated-scene identity comparison.

review_limitations: Aesthetic and adult-appearance assessments are AI visual judgments, not human artistic acceptance or proof of exact depicted ages.

All 20 native images and all 20 phone derivatives were inspected individually, and continuity was reviewed in all four anonymous bundles; no thumbnail or contact-sheet-only assessment was substituted.
Scores describe observable pixels and their fit to the neutral brief. No source, API, renderer, authorship or provider claims can be established from these views and none were inferred.
The safe margins were assessed visually at native size, with extra native views for three close cases; exact object segmentation or a separate numerical technical QA was not performed.
Readability was assessed from the supplied 360x203 derivative on the review display, not from a physical phone or human viewing study.
The report records scores before identity reveal and is ready for the coordinator to hash-freeze before any mapping is read.

The mature face, brown skin, ruby flower and green gown remain distinct above a luminous lily pool at phone size.

fairness_limits: The scene brief, adult cast, high effort label, 1920×1080 dimensions, t=0, seed424242, three-file schema, 256KiB decoded source ceiling and pinned painting engine stayed fixed.

The first eight outer invocations used a coordinator-chosen 1200-second cutoff. Recovery removed that cutoff for every unfinished lane. Sol/Astra resumed saved corrections; Claude initial calls lacked persisted sessions and were restarted with the same model and brief.

Two ten-second GPT recovery invocations were stopped by a coordinator guard false positive on unrelated INFO metadata. No provider model error occurred. The guard was repaired and the same saved corrections resumed; all attempts remain recorded.

Each model has at most one completed initial package and one completed visual-feedback correction. Historical Claude correction calls had no completed initial source to assess; each recovered initial receives its first actual visual correction under the same six headings. No extra artistic variant, cross-model source reuse or coordinator drawing edit.

Outer CLI invocations and completed creative packages are counted separately. Provider automatic output-limit continuations are recorded where exposed; the schema retry cap does not disable those continuations. Hidden provider response counts and computation are not fully exposed.

Claude source transport was divided into files in the same persistent session after provider output-token limits. Previously completed files and frozen source prefixes stayed fixed across those calls. Each actual Claude visual correction used one frozen feedback packet and the same file-by-file transport, with no rendering, feedback, file replacement or extra creative variant between files. Automatic provider output-limit continuations inside a file call are disclosed separately. The final package joins exact completed authored file bytes; all component call and source hashes are recorded.

Recovery durations and accumulated retry time differ. Equal effort labels do not imply equal internal computation or provider token limits, and these measurements are not a clean speed/cost benchmark.

Usage fields are authoritative per-invocation completed CLI-result usage where available. Thinking-progress estimates and partial assistant usage from interrupted calls are excluded from totals. Cached/resumed input is included as the CLI reports it. Resumed Claude modelUsage and dollar estimates accumulate over the persistent session and must not be summed across calls. Actual subscription charges are unexposed and null; dollar values use CLI list prices.

Source and technical pixel QA were unblinded. A fresh reviewer inspected every neutral native image and 360px derivative plus anonymous continuity bundles; the report hash was frozen before model identities were revealed. AI artistic judgment is not human acceptance.
No paid API fallback, provider substitution, purchased credits, external image generation, copyrighted pose-reference publication or drawing-source repair was used.

sol.colour_and_painted_craft: All five are bright and colourful, with paper texture and fine ink. Broad flat fills and hard polygon-like tree joints/cloth edges dominate; use more transparent layered colour, curved organic contours and delicate hatching to suggest volume while retaining the vivid palette.
sol.anatomy_cloth_contact: P01: crossed knees are mostly implied by the gown, while exposed calves read parallel; make the actual knee overlap clearer. Preserve the seated hip/root support and two visible feet; refine the neck/shoulder joins and angular hands. P02: supporting heel/root contact is slightly ambiguous; make its grounding/shadow unambiguous and soften lifted knee/calf transition. P03: raised hand is small and flattened, refine joined palm/thumb/fingers. P04: wrists/palms have abrupt joins; refine conversational hands. P05: gown reads like widely separated stiff trouser legs; make it flow as continuous cloth over natural legs.
sol.composition_phone_readability: Whole poses, meaningful hands/feet and heads are within the safe margin in P01/P02/P04/P05; P03 is a legitimate medium portrait. All five read at 360px. Preserve figure scale and open faces. P05 forest branches have conspicuous angular splice-like joins; make its vast canopy more organically twisting and asymmetrical.
sol.expression_drama: P03 gaze is attentive but subtle brow/lip acting could be clearer. P04 people are distinct and face each other, but expressions are fairly calm; add adult disagreement through brows, mouth and shoulders without aggression or occlusion. Keep the confident awake queen.
sol.character_continuity: Titania and Helena stay recognizable across their paired scenes. Hermia P03 hair reads long straight with small loops more than chestnut curls; strengthen the fixed curls while keeping her rich warm brown face and ruby flower pin. P05 Puck reads mature but shares a soft face and long straight hair; follow his original adult angular jaw/dark curly hair/leaf ears and violet-teal tunic, trousers and boots. Do not change the fixed cast.
sol.technical_brief_compliance: All five rendered at 1920x1080 and t=0, no clipping, text, nudity or consent issues observed; source audit and syntax passed. Maintain exact three-file package, loop seeds and engine constraints. One complete replacement package is the only remaining creative pass.

astra.colour_and_painted_craft: All five have vivid magenta/sapphire/emerald and luminous teal woods, paper texture and fine ink. Large flat shapes, rigid angular limb/cloth edges and branch splice-like corners weaken the requested organic watercolour feel; layer transparent pigment and soften contours with curved organic forms and delicate hatching.
astra.anatomy_cloth_contact: P01: crossed calves read clearly, but ensure the crossing is distinctly knee-over-knee, not only ankles. The bracing hand hovers above the mossy seat; give its palm credible contact/support and preserve two feet. P02: lifted right foot/action are clear and planted foot reads grounded; refine rigid lifted knee and pelvis/cloth shape. P03: hand at collarbone has overlapping angular finger lines; clarify five joined digits and wrist. P04: open hands and elbows are rigid; soften natural joints. P05: seated Puck support is credible but angular hips/thighs and tiny bent arms need refinement.
astra.composition_phone_readability: All essential pose features stay inside the safe margin and phone silhouettes read well. Preserve scale. P05 queen and Puck are distinct, but foreground roots and canopy have abrupt geometric joints; emphasize vast asymmetrical twisting branches rather than a assembled arch.
astra.expression_drama: The face contour lines cross eye/cheek planes like construction bars, especially P01/P02/P04/P05; remove confusing facial guide-like lines while retaining mature features. P03 should show a subtler raised brow and attentive parted lips toward the off-frame voice. P04 disagreement is readable but strengthen distinct emotional responses through adult eyebrows/mouth/shoulders.
astra.character_continuity: Hair colours, pins, costumes and recognizable adult identities are coherent in paired scenes. Preserve Titania36, Helena30, Hermia28 and Puck35 original designs. Puck has a mature jaw/ears and is secondary; keep that.
astra.technical_brief_compliance: All five rendered at1920x1080/t=0, source audit and syntax passed; no text, clipping, nudity or consent problems observed. Some fine gold/ink lines extend across the body or background without clear physical purpose (notably P01 waist and P05 hands); remove unintended stray strokes. Keep the exact three-file interface and fixed loop seeds. One complete replacement package is the only remaining creative pass.

opus.colour_and_painted_craft: Bright magenta/cobalt/emerald/teal, luminous washes, paper grain and fine ink are present. Broad flat figure fills dominate. Wood has sharply squared branch junctions and parallel polygon slabs, especially P02/P04/P05; improve organic contours, transparent wash volume and subtle face/cloth modelling while preserving the vivid palette.
opus.anatomy_cloth_contact: P01 clearly reads as a supported seated crossed-knee pose with two slippers and a palm on the root seat; preserve it. P02 has readable separate planted/lifted shoes and a clearing stride, but elbow/wrist joints are angular and the layered blue/teal cloth can read like separated trouser legs. P03 raised fingers and hand are attached, but finger roots and wrist are blocky. P04 conversational hands remain stiff at the wrists. P05 Titania gown/slit is continuous with grounded slippers; Puck sits on a supporting branch with boots and a bracing hand. Soften joins and add believable cloth tension rather than changing these poses.
opus.composition_phone_readability: Inspected all P01–P05 native1920x1080 and phone360x203 pairs. Essential heads, shoes and gesturing hands are inside the wide frames; P03 is an intentional medium portrait. All five scene silhouettes remain readable at phone size. P05 canopy scale is clear; preserve framing and safe margins. Rectangular branch ends distract in the panoramic court.
opus.expression_drama: Awake poised Titania and alert Helena; Hermia has readable off-frame eyes and lips. P04 mostly reads as a calm exchange, with weak contrasting brow/mouth acting. Strengthen the disagreement through distinct brows, mouth shapes and hand intent. Faces/long necks feel flat and stiff, particularly Helena P02/P04; keep adult proportions while improving volume.
opus.character_continuity: Titania retains auburn hair, crown, teal earrings and magenta/gold; Helena blonde braid and cobalt/teal/gold; Hermia warm brown skin, chestnut curls and ruby flower across P03/P04. Puck has short dark hair, violet/teal tunic, trousers and boots in P05, but mature stubble and leaf-shaped ear identity are weak or absent. Make those adult Puck markers legible without changing the cast.
opus.technical_brief_compliance: All five native stills and exact phone derivatives rendered from the independently audited unchanged three-file source at frozen1920x1080,t=0,seed424242/engine/settings. No text, explicit content, sleeping/enchanted staging or clipped essential anatomy observed; all characters appear awake and adult. Keep the original non-explicit fashion scenes, static loops and technical settings. This is the sole actual visual correction.

fable.colour_and_painted_craft: Bright magenta/cobalt/emerald/teal and luminous clouded green/purple background washes with paper grain are successful. Figures and trunks remain flat geometric fills; branches look like cut parallel slabs with square junctions. Improve organic wood contours, transparent face/cloth volume and layered petal shapes, especially the stamped star-like P03 lilies, while preserving jewel colours and fine ink.
fable.anatomy_cloth_contact: P01 has a supported crossed-knee pose, two slippers and palms touching root/knee, but hip/skirt contact and the magenta knee overlap read as angular patches. P02 has a distinct lifted leading shoe and planted other foot, but stiff elbows/wrists, flat arm planes and an abrupt neck/shoulder join. P03 collarbone hand is attached yet finger roots and forearm look blocky; preserve the other palm on the pool rim. P04 gesturing hands have rectangular palms and detached-looking finger joins; shoes meet the ground. P05 Titania has a continuous gown/slit with grounded slippers; Puck sits on a supporting branch with bracing palms, but his boots overlap into a hooked shape and forearms are very stiff. Improve joints, cloth tension and separate boot silhouettes without changing compositions.
fable.composition_phone_readability: All five native1920x1080 and phone360x203 pairs were individually inspected. Essential heads, hands and shoes remain inside the frames; P03 is an intentional medium portrait. The distinct seated/stride/portrait/two-person/canopy scenes are legible at phone size. Preserve the wide safe framing. P05 Puck is small but identifiable; branch slabs and large flat star-shaped flowers distract from the court.
fable.expression_drama: Faces are frontal and doll-like with large eyes and little volume. P03 Hermia looks directly toward the viewer rather than clearly off-frame; correct her eye direction. P04 Helena and Hermia are awake and gesturing, but raised calm brows and similar mouth shapes make disagreement weak. Add contrasting brows, mouth tension and purposeful hand intent. Preserve Titania's awake composure and Helena's alert stride while using clearly adult facial proportions.
fable.character_continuity: Titania retains auburn hair/crown/teal earrings/magenta-gold; Helena blonde braid/cobalt-teal-gold; Hermia warm brown skin/chestnut curls/ruby flower/emerald across P03/P04. P05 Puck has short dark hair and violet tunic/trousers/boots, but mature stubble and leaf-shaped ear identity are absent or too weak and his tiny frontal face reads youthful. Make Puck unmistakably a35-year-old adult with mature face/neck proportions, visible stubble and leaf-shaped ears, retaining his clothed supported branch pose.
fable.technical_brief_compliance: All five static native stills and exact phone derivatives rendered from the independently audited unchanged three-file source at frozen1920x1080,t=0,seed424242/engine/settings. No text, explicit content, sleeping/enchanted staging or essential frame clipping observed. Keep the original adult awake non-explicit fashion scenes and unchanged static loops/settings. This is the sole actual visual correction; improve mature Puck identity as noted above.
